parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bottle, made of transparent plastic (PET). It is cylindrical with a tapered neck and forms the largest part of the bottle.
parts.Functional_description: The body serves as the main container for holding liquids or other substances. It provides structural integrity and volume capacity.
parts.Movement_description: The body is a fixed part of the bottle and does not move independently. It is grasped when the bottle is used or carried.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid or cap of the bottle, made of opaque plastic (PP). It is smaller and fits onto the neck of the bottle.
parts.Functional_description: The lid seals the bottle to prevent leakage or contamination. It can be screwed or snapped on and off for access to the contents.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can rotate or be removed from the bottle body, allowing opening and closing actions.
